title: Cinobufagin suppresses T-ALL via USP7-Mediated inhibition of NOTCH1/PI3K signaling pathways.
authors: Wang, Jiahe; Cheng, Yiran; Xiang, Yujie; Zhang, Hong; Wang, Chen; Wang, Ying; Wu, Huimin; Cheng, Siyu; Ye, Jing; Zhang, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟾毒灵通过USP7抑制NOTCH1/PI3K通路治疗T-ALL，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) is a highly heterogeneous disease which has low survival rate and liable to recurrence. Cinobufagin (CBG) is an active ingredient extracted from traditional Chinese medicine ChanSu, which exerts inhibitory effect in various cancers. However, the therapeutic effect of CBG on T-ALL remains still unknown. This study demonstrated that CBG induced apoptosis in T-ALL cells by activating Caspase-3 signaling pathway and concurrently arrested the cell cycle of T-ALL cells. Mechanistically, Ubiquitin-specific protease 7 (USP7) was shown to be overexpressed in T-ALL cells, and USP7 knockdown induced apoptosis in Jurkat cells. Moreover, knockdown of USP7 resulted in the blockage of NOTCH1 and PI3K pathways. Cellular thermal shift assay (CESTA) and molecular docking demonstrated that CBG suppressed the abnormal activation of USP7 in T-ALL cells, further interrupting the NOTCH1 and Phosphatidylinositol-3 kinase (PI3K) pathways. Furthermore, the overexpression of USP7 in Jurkat xenograft mice promoted the pathenogenesis of T-ALL. CBG displayed therapeutic effect by inhibiting the expression of USP7, without inducing significant liver damage. Overall, this study demonstrated that CBG induced apoptosis of T-ALL cells by targeting USP7 and further regulating NOTCH1/PI3K pathways.
abstract_zh: T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病（T-ALL）是一种高度异质性疾病，其生存率低且易复发。蟾蜍灵（Cinobufagin, CBG）是从中药蟾酥中提取的活性成分，在多种癌症中发挥抑制作用。然而，CBG对T-ALL的治疗效果仍不清楚。本研究表明，CBG通过激活Caspase-3信号通路诱导T-ALL细胞凋亡，并同时阻滞T-ALL细胞的细胞周期。机制上，泛素特异性蛋白酶7（Ubiquitin-specific protease 7, USP7）在T-ALL细胞中过表达，且USP7敲低可诱导Jurkat细胞凋亡。此外，USP7敲低导致NOTCH1和PI3K通路受阻。细胞热位移分析（CESTA）和分子对接 (molecular docking) 表明，CBG抑制T-ALL细胞中USP7的异常激活，进一步干扰NOTCH1和磷脂酰肌醇-3激酶（Phosphatidylinositol-3 kinase, PI3K）通路。进一步地，在Jurkat异种移植小鼠中，USP7的过表达促进了T-ALL的发病。CBG通过抑制USP7表达发挥治疗效果，且未诱导显著肝损伤。总体而言，本研究证明CBG通过靶向USP7并进一步调节NOTCH1/PI3K通路诱导T-ALL细胞凋亡。
